# File drop zone (`file-drop-zone`)

Drop files or browse.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createFileDropZone` (types in `dist/web/pickers/fileDropZone.d.ts`): `.mh-drop-zone`: a dashed area that takes dropped files (`.is-dragover` while files hover) and a Browse button for the native file chooser, so it works the same without a mouse, on touch screens and from the keyboard. Checks type, size and count; refusals are announced in a live message (`.is-invalid`). Kept files are listed with their sizes and remove buttons.

```ts
export function createFileDropZone(options: FileDropZoneOptions = {}): FileDropZoneHandle;

export interface FileDropZoneOptions {
  /** Main line (default "Drop files here"; on touch screens only the button shows). */
  title?: string;
  /** What's accepted, e.g. "PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB". */
  hint?: string;
  /** The browse button (default "Browse files", or "Choose a file" with `multiple: false`). */
  buttonLabel?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Like the input's `accept`: MIME types (`image/*`, `application/pdf`) and extensions (`.json`). */
  accept?: string;
  /** Allows several files (default true). */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Largest file in bytes. */
  maxSize?: number;
  /** Most files kept in the list (with `multiple`). */
  maxFiles?: number;
  /** Lists the kept files with remove buttons (default true). */
  showList?: boolean;
  name?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  locale?: string;
  /** Files were added (accepted ones) and refused (with why). */
  onFiles?: (accepted: File[], rejected: FileRejection[]) => void;
  /** The kept list changed (added or removed). */
  onChange?: (files: File[]) => void;
}

export interface FileDropZoneHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  button: HTMLButtonElement;
  getFiles(): File[];
  /** Adds files as if dropped (validated the same way). */
  addFiles(files: Iterable<File>): void;
  removeFile(index: number): void;
  clear(): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`formatFileSize` (types in `dist/web/pickers/fileDropZone.d.ts`): "4.2 MB": a byte count in the largest unit that keeps it at or above one.

```ts
export function formatFileSize(bytes: number, locale?: string): string;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createFileDropZone, formatFileSize } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');

// Files that are too big, of the wrong type or too many are refused with a message in the zone.
const plans = createFileDropZone({
  title: 'Drop floor plans here',
  hint: 'PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB each, up to 4 files',
  accept: 'image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp',
  maxSize: 5_000_000,
  maxFiles: 4,
  onChange: (files) => {
    const total = files.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);
    status.textContent = files.length ? `${files.length} ready to upload, ${formatFileSize(total)}.` : '';
  },
});

document.body.append(plans.el, status);
```

## React API

`FileDropZone` (types in `dist/react/pickers.d.ts`): `createFileDropZone` in a host; `disabled` and `error` follow the props. The file list is the widget's own.

```ts
export function FileDropZone({ className, error, disabled, onFiles, onChange, title, hint, buttonLabel, icon, accept, multiple, maxSize, maxFiles, showList, name, locale }: FileDropZoneProps);

export interface FileDropZoneProps extends Omit<FileDropZoneOptions, 'onFiles' | 'onChange'> {
  className?: string;
  /** An error to show (e.g. from an upload that failed). */
  error?: string;
  onFiles?: FileDropZoneOptions['onFiles'];
  onChange?: FileDropZoneOptions['onChange'];
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileDropZone } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { formatFileSize } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function FileDropZoneExample() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const total = files.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);
  return (
    <>
      {/* Files that are too big, of the wrong type or too many are refused with a message in the zone. */}
      <FileDropZone
        title="Drop floor plans here"
        hint="PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB each, up to 4 files"
        accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
        maxSize={5_000_000}
        maxFiles={4}
        onChange={setFiles}
      />
      {files.length > 0 && <p>{`${files.length} ready to upload, ${formatFileSize(total)}.`}</p>}
    </>
  );
}
```
